idle_gate.waiver_basis: A load-average threshold is a proxy. CUDA-event device time measures execution on the GPU and is immune to host scheduling, so agreement between wall-clock p95 and device p95 is direct evidence that the tail is uncontaminated, and disagreement is direct evidence that it is. The verdict status is decided by that agreement, not by the proxy.

quality_join_rationale: cost may be placed on the same axes as quality only for the geometry whose models the quality source actually trained; the ranker geometry is a width stand-in and was never trained
